description: According to the Death Penalty Information Center, which publishes data and analysis on capital punishment in the United States, Pike is the first inmate ever to survive 'after being injected with lethal doses of execution drugs.'
title: Christa Pike is conscious and speaking after botched execution

description: Coming in first place in the first round of Brazil's presidential election on Sunday, October 4, with 47% of the vote, the eldest son of former president Jair Bolsonaro is under police investigation for money laundering and corruption.
title: In Brazil, scandals fail to slow Flavio Bolsonaro's political rise

description: The death of an employee at the Irkutsk Research Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia on Friday, October 2, has sparked concern despite reassurances from Russian authorities and the World Health Organization (WHO).
title: Pneumonic plague: What we know about treatment and transmission of this disease that has 'not disappeared from the planet'

description: The Al-Nassr superstar said he accepts any 'suspension' or 'punishment,' while accusing coach Jorge Jesus of breaking his word.
title: Ronaldo apologizes to team and supporters for walkout

description: The French president hailed it as 'a remarkable demonstration of credibility and an important milestone' at a time when Russia is stepping up its hybrid warfare against Europe and continuing to wield the nuclear threat.
title: Macron makes unexpected appearance at missile test launch from nuclear submarine

description: The 18-year-old's Instagram videos have gone viral. A winner of a public speaking competition, she works with a group encouraging youth from working-class neighborhoods to get involved in politics.
title: Who is Soumaya Sarré, a student inspiring France's high school protests?

description: Before attempting to open dialogue, the French government handled the current high school student protests as if they were urban riots, sociologist Vincent Tiberj observes in an interview.
title: 'The French government's condescension toward high school students shows a refusal to take them seriously as citizens'

description: The two prominent Hollywood studios merged into a film, television and news conglomerate under control of the Trump-linked Ellison family on Tuesday, as Paramount completed its takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery after a fierce bidding war and opposition from 12 US states.
title: Paramount completes takeover of Warner Bros, creating Skydance media empire

description: Regulators have ordered the company representing the US web giant in Finland to stop building data centers until it can demonstrate compliance with environmental laws. Officials are investigating whether trees and soil were cleared before the company carried out an impact study.
title: Finland orders halt to work on Google data centers over environmental concerns

description: A writer, statesman and minister several times over, Cheikh Hamidou Kane was both a major witness to and a participant in Senegal's contemporary history. He died in Dakar on October 3, at 98 years old.
title: Cheikh Hamidou Kane, voice of Senegalese history, has died

description: At an event commemorating the victims of October 7, hard-left MEP Rima Hassan removed an Israeli flag from a stand to 'denounce the ongoing genocide' in Gaza. The president of the European Parliament said she was taking the allegation 'extremely seriously.'
title: French MEP accused of removing Israeli flag at European Parliament exhibition

description: The deputy permanent representative of France to the UN, Jay Dharmadhikari, made clear France's refusal to let the UN intervene in discussions about the territory's future.
title: Macron closes door on UN-led talks over French Polynesia's future

description: Organizers claimed 450,000 people marched across the country, while the Interior Ministry said 256,000.
title: Hundreds of thousands demonstrate across France for better education

description: The arrest came a day after President Trump said the US had withdrawn all B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford because of 'threats' he believed were linked to Tehran.
title: Police make seventh arrest over UK airbase incident

description: The Provisional Electoral Council said Tuesday that presidential and legislative elections planned for December and February would be postponed indefinitely. The country has been without a leader since the assassination of President Jovenel Moïse in 2021.
title: Haiti postpones elections amid gang violence and political chaos

description: Wanying Zhang, a California resident, was arrested on Sunday in Los Angeles. She is accused of surveilling the family of Lai Ching-te on behalf of Beijing, which considers Taiwan one of its provinces and labels its president a separatist.
title: Chinese woman arrested in the US for spying on Taiwanese president's son

description: The French start-up, accused of falling behind in AI model performance, is banking on Mistral Large 4, available from Tuesday.
title: Mistral AI unveils new AI model aimed at 'narrowing the gap' with top Chinese competitors

description: France's armed forces test-fired a new M51.3 nuclear-capable ballistic missile in the Atlantic Ocean on Tuesday, the defense ministry said. President Emmanuel Macron said the test 'demonstrates the credibility' of France's nuclear deterrent.
title: France completes test of new nuclear-capable missile

description: While she was still a student, a young woman claimed that she was drugged and raped by seven members of a fraternity at the Ivy League university. Many students feel that the alleged perpetrators were not punished severely enough. In September, the plaintiff took her case to the New York State Supreme Court.
title: On Cornell's campus, 'everyone is outraged' by the handling of gang rape case

description: In his first four matches as France manager, Zinédine Zidane has already initiated several breaks with his predecessor's style.
title: Three ways Zidane's France is already different from Deschamps'

description: Far-right presidential election candidate Marine Le Pen presented her party's shadow budget plan, which promises €140 billion in cost savings over five years, bringing the deficit back under 3% of GDP by 2030 and a budgetary referendum.
title: Le Pen vows drastic budget cuts to prevent French 'default' on debt

description: Following his party's victory, Paul St-Pierre Plamondon is set to become Québec's 34th prime minister, with the promise of an independence referendum in sight.
title: Québec's independence back to the table after Parti Québécois election win

description: The far-right party closed ranks behind its president despite the evidence of his past antisemitic writings published by investigative news site Mediapart. Jordan Bardella's loss of credibility could taint Marine Le Pen's presidential campaign.
title: Defending Bardella no matter what, Marine Le Pen's risky strategy

description: August Hanning, who ran Germany's Federal Intelligence Service between 1998 and 2005, is suspected of charges including 'attempted treason' and 'espionage,' according to a statement from federal prosecutors on Tuesday.
title: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage, treason

description: Israel Katz, the Israeli defense minister, ordered the military on Tuesday to increase its level of vigilance in the Palestinian enclave.
title: Israel threatens to make Gazans pay 'heavy price' for any Hamas attack during October 7 anniversary

description: The physicist won the prize for his contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and his discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin.
title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics awarded to Belgium's Francis Halzen for his work on subatomic particles at the South Pole

description: Authorities say the death of a laboratory worker in Irkutsk was not caused by the plague bacterium. But the scale of the quarantine measures, conflicting official statements and information censorship have raised questions.
title: Russia's reassurances only fuel anxiety over suspected plague outbreak in Siberia

description: From the Paris suburbs to Marseille, as well as Toulouse and Lyon, high schoolers interviewed by Le Monde during the blockades described their study conditions, their concerns and their need to be heard.
title: What students are voicing during high school blockades: 'I am worried about my future and for all students in France'

description: Teenagers are complaining about missing teachers, overloaded timetables, dilapidated classrooms and buildings ill-equipped for high temperatures. While many protests have been peaceful, some were marked by clashes with police.
title: Unions join high school students as tens of thousands demonstrate across France

description: Since July, the bodies of women found either naked or half-naked and brutally beaten have been discovered on the outskirts of the South African capital. Although the theory of a serial predator has faded, the grim reality of widespread daily violence against women in the country has become undeniable.
title: Discovery of 11 bodies in Johannesburg exposes scale of violence against women

description: The Parti Québecois, having emerged victorious at the polls, warned that a vote on the province's future would not be held before the end of Donald Trump's term, deeming that the current context did not offer a calm climate.
title: Separatists win provincial elections in Québec in test for Canada PM

description: The current protest movement largely reflects the worsening of learning conditions, according to a group of sociologists from the University of Tours who have conducted field research among high school students.
title: 'France's student protests are, above all, a collective expression of how difficult schoolwork has become'

description: Nidal Hasan was sentenced to death by a military jury in 2013 for carrying out the Al-Qaeda inspired mass shooting of 13 people at Fort Hood in Texas.
title: Trump approves firing squad for convicted US military base shooter

description: Among the 251 Israelis taken captive by Hamas on October 7, 2023, Aviva and Keith Siegel chose to speak publicly about the abuse they suffered. While Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has claimed the release of hostages as an achievement in his election campaign, the couple in their 60s has continued to oppose the war.
title: Three years after October 7: Despite pain, two former Hamas hostages promote message of peace

description: The author, whose novels sold over 300 million copies, had hoped to become mayor of London, but several scandals ended his political career.
title: Best-selling British author and fomer Conservative politician Jeffrey Archer dies, aged 86

description: As the budget debate approaches, La France Insoumise MP Eric Coquerel presents a strikingly high assessment of the consequences of the summer's extreme temperatures, aiming to build a stronger case for increasing funds allocated to adapting the country to climate change.
title: Summer 2026 heatwave cost France €16 billion, says Assemblée Nationale report

description: By bringing forward elections initially scheduled for mid-2027 to November 29, the Socialist prime minister seeks to regain the initiative and hopes to end a legislative term marred by scandals and the extreme fragility of his majority.
title: Spanish PM Sanchez once again bets on the ballot box amid housing crisis unrest

description: France, who also beat Belgium 1-0 in Brussels last week thanks to a late goal by Michael Olise, moved three points clear of Italy at the top of Group A1, with Belgium another point back.
title: Olise powers France to 4-1 win over Belgium in Nations League
